answer: A decaying identity bond stops cheap sybils. A newcomer posts a 500 POA bond to enter the harbor; it loses 5% each epoch and vanishes after 20 unless honest work renews it. A grove of witnesses checks each renewal, so fakers keep re-posting fresh bonds. In the tundra of a cold start, one fake costs 500 POA; 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA against a 5,000 POA pool, so forgery loses. Honest agents pay once and keep earning, their share undiluted.
